description: Verify an x402 v2 PrivatePAY payload through the configured facilitator against the exact original requirements. Call this after privatepay_challenge or privatepay_checkout and before privatepay_settle; it is read-only, fail-closed, and returns redacted evidence without spending funds.

inputSchema.description: Verify an x402 v2 PrivatePAY payload against the exact challenge requirements through the configured facilitator. This is read-only, fail-closed, and returns redacted structured evidence; call it before privatepay_settle.

paymentPayload.description: The payer wallet's finalized x402 payment payload, including the accepted scheme and transaction proof.

paymentRequirements.description: The exact requirements returned by privatepay_challenge or privatepay_checkout; do not substitute a guessed amount or recipient.

name: privatepay_verify

outputSchema.description: Structured validation evidence for an x402 payment payload.
